figures.finding: Angola's Regulation of the Cinema and Audiovisual Law (Presidential Decree 195/26 of 30 September 2026, under Law 7/12) has the State's film and audiovisual support paid as non-repayable grants through the Fundo Nacional do Cinema e do Audiovisual, with the fund's rules and award rules left to a joint executive decree of the culture and finance ministers; State support for distribution, for festival participation by independent producers and for festivals in Angola may not exceed 50% of the budgeted cost. No amounts are set in the regulation.

value.law: Lei n.º 7/12, de 18 de Janeiro (Lei do Cinema e do Audiovisual)
value.regulation: Decreto Presidencial n.º 195/26, de 30 de Setembro
value.fund: Fundo Nacional do Cinema e do Audiovisual

sources.said: Decreto Presidencial n.2 195/26 … Havendo a necessidade de regulamentar-se a Lei n.2 7/12, de 18 de Janeiro — Lei do Cinema e do Audiovisual … Diploma possuem natureza nado reembolsavel, e devem ser disponibilizados através do Fundo Nacional do Cinema e do Audiovisual … nado pode exceder até 50% do custo orcamentado do plano de distribuicdo das obras elegiveis … O apoio do Estado a conceder ao produtor independente nacional nao pode exceder 50%

figures.finding: Angola's regulation makes statistical registration with the agency overseeing cinema and audiovisual mandatory for production companies and for producers, directors, screenwriters and other film professionals, and lets the State grant tax incentives 'under the law' to attract productions that promote Angola; no incentive rate is set in it.

value.registration: mandatory (registo estatístico), with the cinema and audiovisual agency
value.taxIncentive: possible under the law; none set in the regulation
